decisions.reason: The existing message-33 MODIFY already fully captures the required original, non-copying adaptation mode; no additional update or removal is needed.
The testimonial presentation examples do not change the viral hook style, opening standard, or attention-capture window.
The source changes creative presentation but does not alter the lead-generation objective or target CPL.
Couple or patient testimonials can use the existing realistic native-looking UGC style without changing its realism criteria.
The presentation examples do not rescind the Indian-only casting rule or the existing preference for male actors.
The testimonial format does not change the required color grading or polished native-UGC finish.
Speaking testimonial scenes remain subject to the existing proper lip-sync standard; the standard itself is unchanged.
The new presentation direction does not change the freelancer's full-service responsibility for footage, voiceover, and script.
The references to couples and patients do not change the specified audience age range.
The testimonial presentation change does not alter the requirement for an organically incorporated call to action.
The source does not change the professional mobile-optimized subtitle standard.
The source changes who presents testimonial feedback, not the source material or substance of product benefits and claims.
